name: Franklin Leasing and Finance Limited
about: Franklin Leasing and Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, primarily provides financial services in India. The company also engages in the business of advancing loans; and offers various financial services, including inter-corporate deposits, personal loans, and unsecured loans, as well as loans against property. In addition, it is involved in investing/trading in securities. Franklin Leasing and Finance Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Delhi, India.
